name: Smartlead
description: Smartlead lets agents read and manage email campaigns, leads, and sending accounts, and check campaign statistics and deliverability, in the Smartlead account of the signed-in user.

prompts.text: Which campaigns had the highest reply rate last week?
Which of my email accounts have warmup problems?
Draft a three-step follow-up sequence for a new campaign, but do not start it.

apps.name: Smartlead
apps.description: Campaigns, leads, and deliverability, over Smartlead's MCP server with browser sign-in.
